top_signals.title: Trump Xi Summit Leaves Big Issues Unresolved
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg North Asia correspondent Stephen Engle tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping bought more time to negotiate over trade while major disagreements involving Taiwan, Iran and technology remain. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Engle explains how competition over AI and unresolved economic and security issues are shaping the next phase of US-China relations. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed requests comment on two proposals for stablecoin issuers under GENIUS Act
top_signals.summary: US regulatory agencies missed a rule-making deadline under the GENIUS Act, a year after the law was signed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
